# getnamed

> Bilingual digital studio in Montréal building brands and websites for companies that refuse to be ignored. Found on Google, named in AI answers, in French and English.

## What getnamed does

- Brand identity: naming, logo and visual identity, brand voice: the assets that make a company citable.
- Websites: designed, written and built to convert. Fast, bilingual, compliant.
- SEO: technical foundations, local visibility, content that ranks on classic search engines.
- GEO / AEO: getting clients named inside AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity) through structured data, semantic markup and citation-ready content.
- Content and copy: Quebec French written natively in Quebec, English written to sound like the client. Spanish available.
- Measurement: reporting built around qualified leads and cost per lead.

## Positioning

- Tagline: "Be the answer." / « Soyez la référence. »
- Ethos: a website should do more than represent a business; it should grow it. Design earns attention; strategy turns attention into action. getnamed treats websites as growth assets built to generate leads, increase conversions, and maximize return on marketing spend.
- Working languages: English, French (Canada), Spanish.

## Facts

- Location: Montréal, Québec, Canada
- Email: info@getnamed.ca
- Site: https://getnamed.ca/
- Pricing model: fixed, published, approved before work starts
- Ownership: clients own their domain, site, analytics, ad accounts and content
- Contracts: plain terms, ongoing work on 30 days' notice
